assessmentRole: release-builder review; not independent human assessment
disposition: reviewable analytical draft; rejected for unreviewed operational reliance
supported: Correctly extracts recorded test counts and coverage percentages.
Identifies missing evidence of live commissioning and distinguishes test passes from production operation.

correctionsRequired: Coverage percentages and test counts do not establish robust code quality or general functional completeness.
Missing deployment evidence in these supplied sources is not proof no deployment exists anywhere.

The suggestion that narrow demonstrations might suffice contradicts the completion contract, which explicitly says a passing narrow demonstration is insufficient.
The task was a review of v3.0 evidence; its test counts must not be described as the new v3.1 results.
The two role prompts use one model controlled by one harness, not independent assessors.
executionChecks: Schema, exact quote presence, signatures, replay and encrypted recovery passed. These checks do not prove semantic entailment.
